notes_zh:
- **修复** 开机自启动后，状态栏「主管理器 / 设置 / 自动化规则」点击无响应的问题（#66，感谢 @Zxxxxxl @miniers @ghostman-git 的反馈）
- **新增** 「导出诊断日志」（设置 → 通用）
notes_en:
- **Fix** Status-bar "Manager / Settings / Automation rules" not responding when the app was launched at login (#66, thanks @Zxxxxxl @miniers @ghostman-git for the reports)
- **New** "Export Diagnostic Log" (Settings → General)

beta.notes_zh:
- **修复** 针对图片、视频等非文本内容的自动化规则现在能正常触发（例如「自动移入分组」），此前这类规则完全不执行（#71，感谢 @hiby-arch 的反馈）
- **修复** 在快捷面板手动应用「移入分组 / 置顶 / 标记敏感」类规则现在能正确生效
- **修复** 规则编辑器中「移入分组」动作显示异常（行高过高、标签丢失）
- **优化** 含「运行快捷指令」的规则锁定为手动触发，避免误设为自动时静默不执行
- **优化** 图片类规则的触发通知不再显示 "[Image]" 占位文本，改为显示内容类型
beta.notes_en:
- **Fix** Automation rules targeting non-text content (images, videos, etc.) now trigger correctly — e.g. "move to group" — they previously never ran at all (#71, thanks @hiby-arch for the report)
- **Fix** Manually applying "move to group / pin / mark sensitive" rules from the quick panel now works
- **Fix** Display glitch for the "move to group" action in the rule editor (row too tall, label missing)
- **Improve** Rules containing "Run Shortcut" are locked to manual triggering to avoid silently never running when set to automatic
- **Improve** Trigger notifications for image rules show the content type instead of the "[Image]" placeholder
